summary: Assess AI maturity, identify gaps, and build a practical roadmap in 5 days. Train your team to evaluate readiness with confidence.
lede: AI readiness assessment for organizations provides a structured way to evaluate strategy, data, governance, engineering, culture, operations, and value realization. Using a seven-domain readiness lens, structured interviews, questionnaires, evidence collection, and maturity scoring, you can identify gaps and prioritize the use cases that fit your organization’s current state. The training helps you create a readiness scorecard, gap register, AI roadmap draft, and leadership briefing note. You will learn to turn fragmented views of data, governance, operating models, and value tracking into evidence-based findings that support responsible AI adoption and withstand leadership, procurement, and cross-functional review.
audienceIntro: This AI readiness assessment for organizations course is designed for professionals who need to evaluate current capability, align stakeholders, and turn AI ambition into a realistic roadmap.
prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with organizational strategy, data governance, and basic AI terminology. No coding is required for completion, but you should be comfortable reading dashboards, participating in stakeholder interviews, and reviewing evidence such as policies, architecture summaries, use case lists, and governance documents. Prior exposure to AI pilots, digital transformation work, risk management, or business analysis will help you get more from the exercises.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
